title: Destination reservation request: one object or an all-or-nothing batch

slug.description: Explicit English URL segment. Required for a new destination unless englishName is supplied; an existing match keeps its recorded slug.

englishName.description: Established English exonym or accepted proper name in the Latin alphabet; accents are allowed and stripped for the slug. Russian transliteration is forbidden. Required for a new destination unless slug is supplied; also recorded as a known name alias.

destinationId.description: Select an existing canonical ID; never supply a new invented ID. Existing matches, including name/alias matches without this field, do not require slug or englishName.
